Investment Signals
Monthly monitoring of investment signals across 77 target companies
30 major investment promotion projects · 77 target companies selected by MOTIR
5 key investment signals tracked per company · Pre-decision signals only
The 5 Key Investment Signals
1 Supply Chain & Political Risk Management Reducing regional dependency, diversifying supply chains, and addressing regulatory risks
2 Factory Expansion & Diversification of Production Bases New factory opening or facility construction in the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region
3 Capital Raising & Securing Liquidity Getting extra cash by issuing corporate bonds, new share issuance, or bank loans
4 Tech Partnerships & Joint Research Joint R&D, sharing tech licenses, testing new ideas, or buying shares in partner companies
5 Top Executives' Activities C-level executives moving to new positions, business trips to Korea, or checking out local business sites

C O M P A N Y S I G N A L S · 2/6
Signal Details by Company
Boeing
Aerospace & E-Propulsion USA
1 Supply Chain & Political Risk Management No signal in August
2 Factory Expansion & Diversification of Production Bases No signal in August
3 Capital Raising & Securing Liquidity No signal in August
4 Tech Partnerships & Joint Research
Boeing Investment and Technology Collaboration
Boeing signed definitive agreements to transfer Wisk Aero and other subsidiaries to Archer while taking a stake in Archer and establishing an ongoing technology sharing and collaboration arrangement.
Source: Press release · Boeing - News Releases and Statements / Press Releases / Statements Aug 10, 2026
5 Top Executives' Activities No signal in August
Business Developments
Target technology Electric motors and high-power battery propulsion modules for aircraft
Boeing has signed definitive agreements to transfer its Wisk Aero, SkyGrid, and Insitu subsidiaries to Archer Aviation. Under the transaction, Boeing will take a stake in Archer and establish an ongoing collaboration and technology-sharing arrangement. The partnership combines Wisk's pioneering eVTOL and autonomy technologies with Archer's platform to advance the aerospace and defense sector.
Source: Press release · Boeing - News Releases and Statements / Press Releases / Statements Aug 10, 2026
Invest KOREA · Global Investment Signal Monitor · Issue 3 04

C O M P A N Y S I G N A L S · 3/6
Signal Details by Company
Ouster
Lidar & 3D Sensing USA
1 Supply Chain & Political Risk Management No signal in August
2 Factory Expansion & Diversification of Production Bases
Ouster is expanding its LiDAR production capacity to support rising demand, with its production run rate expected to increase from approximately 40,000 units annually toward 100,000 units.
Source: Yahoo Finance Aug 17, 2026
3 Capital Raising & Securing Liquidity No signal in August
4 Tech Partnerships & Joint Research No signal in August
5 Top Executives' Activities No signal in August
Business Developments
Target technology Lidar sensors for robots
Ouster launched Rev8, the world's first native color LiDAR sensor, in the second quarter of 2026. Customer adoption was reflected in several orders exceeding $1 million from major industry leaders, including the world's largest heavy machinery manufacturer. In addition, the company secured a significant contract with the Utah Department of Transportation for its largest LiDAR deployment to cover several hundred intersections across the state.
Source: Yahoo Finance Aug 17, 2026

C O M P A N Y S I G N A L S · 5/6
Signal Details by Company
Nexeon
Battery Anode Materials UK
1 Supply Chain & Political Risk Management No signal in August
2 Factory Expansion & Diversification of Production Bases No signal in August
3 Capital Raising & Securing Liquidity
Completion of £100 Million Investment Round.
The completion of the £100 million ($133 million) investment round includes a £52.6 million ($70 million) commitment from the National Wealth Fund along with new investors Korea Development Bank and Honda Xcelerator Ventures, supporting continued scale-up and commercialisation activities.
Source: Nexeon - Media / Newsroom Aug 31, 2026
4 Tech Partnerships & Joint Research No signal in August
5 Top Executives' Activities No signal in August
Business Developments
Target technology CVD silicon-carbon (Si-C) anode materials
Nexeon announced on August 28, 2026, that its production facility in Gunsan, South Korea, has achieved ISO 9001:2015 certification for quality management systems. The Gunsan facility is the company's first commercial-scale production plant designed for the volume manufacture of silicon-carbon anode materials. This certification provides a strong foundation for supplying global customers at scale.
Source: Nexeon - Media / Newsroom Aug 28, 2026

===== PAGE 9 =====
K E Y D E V E L O P M E N T S · 1/1
Global Business Developments by Company
These companies had no signals in August but reported developments tied directly to their target technologies. All are monitored for emerging signals.
Albemarle
Lithium & Cathode Materials USA
Target technology Cathode raw materials (lithium hydroxide, lithium carbonate)
August Developments
Albemarle reported $1.3 billion in Energy Storage net sales and 65 kilotons LCE in sales volume for the second quarter of 2026. Increased output from the Wodgina mine partially offset the delay in the Talison CGP3 ramp due to a fire, with full-year sales volumes expected to range between 225 and 235 kilotons LCE.
Source: Albemarle - Newsroom / News Aug 5, 2026
